summary: Brazil Potash Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing only quarterly financial statements (IFRS) for Q1 2026. The filing does not disclose any M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event. Routine financial reporting with no transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics beyond standard equity and warrant disclosures. As a non-US issuer's 6-K, it maps to a US 10-Q but lacks any special-situation trigger.
